items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Kay started making the five string basses.

ctx.x: Those five string basses, was it Kay that made those? Kay? No. No.

No. You see, Kay's bass just come up lately. Kay started making the five string basses. But the five string basses has been, see, they used to use those five string basses in the theaters a long time ago, a long, long time ago. Cause I had a old store, I had, I wanted a man to build me a five string bass years and years ago, a Groomer World Music Store in New York. And he used to often talk about it. He used to say that if I, if he listened to me, he could have been selling one of the first five string basses.…
